title: E6 fix round 1: unanswered items are kept not dropped, coerce Jev values, rank outside the bus lock (from review T-0231)
spec:
Fix round on task/T-0216 (commit 978b24a on goal/T-0201). STEP 0: your worktree was cut from goal/T-0201 and lacks that commit; run `git reset --hard task/T-0216` and confirm `git log --oneline -1` shows 978b24a. Then address the opus review T-0231:
1. orchestrator/jev_rank.py rank(): an item whose answer is missing, or whose noul value is not a finite number in [0, 1] after coercion (float() on int/float/numeric string; anything else -> None), keeps p_relevant None and is KEPT (never dropped); only items with a numeric p below the threshold are dropped. A response without an answers map behaves like ask() None (all items kept, unranked). Sorting uses a key that places None after numeric values without comparing None to floats. rank() never raises: wrap the answer parsing in try/except and fall back to the unranked list.
2. orchestrator/handover.py: move every jev_rank call out of the bus flock. Structure: read the bus snapshot under bus.locked(), release, rank the groups (network), then re-acquire the lock only for the plan.md write. Cap the number of Jev requests per handover at 6 (batch the goals' groups into one request per group type when possible) so worst-case latency stays under 6 x timeout.
3. Tests: tests/test_jev_rank.py gains test_missing_answer_kept, test_non_numeric_kept_and_no_raise, test_empty_answers_returns_unranked; tests/test_handover.py gains test_rank_not_called_under_lock (monkeypatch jev.ask to assert bus lock is not held, e.g. via a probe that tries a non-blocking flock) and test_handover_jev_request_cap.
Commit on the task branch when green.
acceptance: git log on the task branch contains 978b24a below the fix commit
All tests from T-0216 still pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

result.summary:
Committed as `5a2cf4d`, sitting directly on top of `978b24a` (T-0216) on `task/T-0233`. Gate ran green before the commit.

## Summary

Fixed round on T-0231 review:

1. **`orchestrator/jev_rank.py`** — added `_coerce_p()` (float() on int/float/numeric-string, requires finite value in [0,1], else `None`). Items with missing answers or non-numeric/out-of-range `noul` keep `p_relevant=None` and are always kept; only numeric scores below threshold get dropped. Sort key `(1, 0.0)`/`(0, -p)` never compares `None` to a float. Answer parsing wrapped in try/except, falling back to the unranked list on any error.

2. **`orchestrator/handover.py`** — `write()` now takes the bus snapshot (`bus.read()` + last events) under `bus.locked()`, releases it, runs all jev_rank scoring unlocked, then re-acquires the lock only for the plan.md compare-and-swap. `maybe_write()` no longer wraps the call to `write()` in its own lock (it was reentrant-nesting the flock across the whole call before). Added `MAX_JEV_REQUESTS = 6`: failed+done tasks per goal are now scored in one combined `_prune_many()` call instead of two, and once the budget is spent, further groups/events pass through unpruned rather than placing more requests.

3. **Tests** — added `test_missing_answer_kept`, `test_non_numeric_kept_and_no_raise`, `test_empty_answers_returns_unranked` to `tests/test_jev_rank.py`; added `test_rank_not_called_under_lock` (probes with a non-blocking flock on `bus.LOCK` from inside a fake `jev.ask`) and `test_handover_jev_request_cap` (8 goals, asserts calls capped at 6) to `tests/test_handover.py`.

**Test output (failures only):** none — `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exited 0; all 23 tests in `test_jev_rank.py` + `test_handover.py` passed, plus the full repo suite via the gate script.
